entities.title: Twelve Banners
entities.summary: A hex-based 4X strategy game made in Godot 4, under construction: cities, workers, 26 technologies, 16 unit types, combat, AI rivals, and online play for up to 12 civilizations on the desktop builds (host-authoritative lockstep over ENet). It runs in the browser (Compatibility renderer, single player) and as desktop builds (Forward+), for players holding the invite-only role games:twelve-banners.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the Godot project in godot/ (rules, AI, networking, and every model and effect made in code, no art assets), the landing page and the play page's static files in web/, the Cloudflare Worker that gates every file on games:twelve-banners in worker/, its tests in test/, and screenshots in docs/. One npm project, built by build.mjs (web export, three desktop exports, the landing page) and deployed as one Worker.
boundaries: The sign-in is icelander.net's; the Worker checks it with the shared library in vendor/icelander-auth/ and the login service, neither edited here.

The role games:twelve-banners is declared in icelander.net's accounts/src/config.js and granted at icelander.net/private/admin; the games list there shows the game, under 'Under construction', only to holders of the role.
No database, no API and no server for matches: online games run between the players' own desktop builds, one of them hosting over ENet (UDP 24565).
